WESTERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
Financial (Amendment) Statute of Western Province Provincial Council No. 01 of 2016

I, Edirisingha Arachchige Isura Dewapriya Dharmasena Perera, Chief Minister and Minister of Finance and Plan Implementation,Engineering Services, Law and Order, Local Government and Provincial Administration, Economic Promotion, Power andEnergy, Enviornmental Affairs, Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism of the Western Province Provincial Council, herebydeclare that Financial (Amendment) Statute, No. 01 of 2016 Western Province Provincial Council, do by this Order with effectfrom 07.09.2016 as Assent by the Honourable Governor of Western Province.

EDIRISINGHA ARACHCHIGE ISURA DEWAPRIYA DHARMASENA PERERA,Chief Minister and Minister of Finance and Plan Implementation,Engineering Services, Law and Order, Local Government and ProvincialAdministrations, Economic Promotion, Power and Energy, Environmental Affairs,
Water Supply and Drainage and Tourism of the Western Province,
Western Province Provincial Council.Office of the Chief Ministry,“Shrawasthri Mandiraya”,Colombo 7,27th August 2016.
WESTERN PROVINCIAL FINANCE (AMENDMENT) STATUTE No. 01 OF 2016
STATUTE TO REVISE WESTERN PROVINCIAL FINANCE STATUTE NO. 06 OF 1990 AMENDED BY STATUTE NO. 04 OF 2014
Be it enacted by the Western Province Provincial Council of Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka :-
01. This Statute Shall be cited as the Western Provincial Finance (Amendment) Statute No. 01 of
2016 and shall come in to effect on such date assented by the Govenor of Western Province.
02. Section 102(a) of the main statute shall be repealed hereby and the following section shall be
substituted instead.
Short Title andDate ofenforcement

102(a) A fund that shall be hereinafter referred to as “Fund” in this Section cited as “Revenue
Incentive Fund” shall be established
(b) An amount appropriated annually by the Western Province Provincial for the purpose of
the Fund on behalf of each year shall be paid to the Fund
(c)(i) Where a revenue has been earned on a statement and/or assessment made by an

assessor considering the matters of conformation that the value stated in anyinstrument, the turnover stated in a report has been stated falsely when inspectingas per provisions of the statute ; and/or not producing reports prescribed to bepresented by any statute executed by the Provincial Commissioner of Revenue ;and/or where as revenue has been collected when any tax/fee specified to be paidby a person as per provisions of any statute executed by Provincial Commissionerof Revenue has not been paid within the specified time period.
Twelve point five percent (12.5%) from the revenue collected thus.
(ii) Five percent from the revenue collected through fines imposed under any statute
executed by the Provincial Commissioner of Revenue.
Shall be credited to the Fund.
(d) From the amount earned under the above mentioned percentages, the incentive for the
officers shall be paid by the Fund according to a scheme formulated by the Commissionerof Revenue and approved by the Minister of Finance.
(e) Provincial Commissioner of Revenue shall administer the Fund in compliance to the
proper procedure of the aforementioned scheme.
(f) The Commissioner, subjected to the approval of the Finance Minister shall formulate
regulations as to which principles and conditions should be incentives be paid for relevantofficers from the money lying at credit in the said Fund.
(g) Subjected to the approval of the Finance Minister, the following money and allowances
shall be paid from the Fund.
(i) Money required for officers' welfare in Provincial Department of Revenue ;
(ii) Collective incentive allowances for all the officers of the Provincial Department
of Revenue to ensure efficiency in execution of certain statute executed by theProvincial Commissioner of Revenue.
(h) Be there any balance at credit in the said Fund subsequent to the payment of incentives to
officers at the end of financial year, it shall be credited to the Provincial Fund.
03. If there is an inconsistency between Sinhala, Tamil and English texts of this Statute, the Sinhala
text shall prevail.
